question: 簡報目前規劃約17分鐘。老師除了至少12分鐘，有沒有規定報告時間上限？
answer: 15分鐘上下，不要超過太多或是太少
interpretation: Target approximately 15 minutes of complete main talk, preserve original at-least-12-minute requirement, exclude appendices and QA. Revise actual script, not only timing fields. Human rehearsal remains unmeasured.
